aloha.subtitle: Your welcome to Imperium
aloha.description: Is it your first time with us? We'll welcome you with 15% off your first treatment and a free assessment so you know exactly what's right for you before you pay a thing.
perks: 15% off your first treatment (anything on the menu)
Free skin or area assessment before you start
Free patch test for laser, Dermapen and micropuncture
We'll give you the price and number of sessions in writing, no obligation
aloha.conditions: Only for first-time clients. One use per person, on a single treatment. Cannot be combined with other offers or applied to packs or packages that are already discounted. Under-18s need permission from a parent or guardian.

ohana.subtitle: Bring your people, you both win
ohana.description: At Imperium we're family. If you bring a friend, partner or family member who's new to us, you both get 20% off: your guest on their first visit and you on your next appointment.
perks: 20% off for your friend or family member on their first treatment
20% off for you on your next treatment
No limit: every new person you bring means another 20% for you
You can come together on the same day and share a treatment room if available
ohana.conditions: Your guest must be a new client and give your name when booking. Your 20% is activated once they complete their first appointment and expires after 3 months. One discount per treatment; cannot be combined with Aloha or other offers, or applied to packs or packages.

packs.name: Silhouette Pack

packs.name: Relax Pack

Personalised appointment schedule before the event
